SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS record_count, 
    CAST(time_stamp AS DATE) AS date 
FROM 
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'silver/deckings', 
        data_source = 'apmt-elz', 
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [decking_status_temp] 
WHERE 
    CAST(time_stamp AS DATE) >= '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 
    CAST(time_stamp AS DATE)
ORDER BY 
    date

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS record_count, 

    CAST(t_put AS DATE) AS date 
FROM 
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'silver/moves', 
        data_source = 'apmt-elz', 
        FORMAT = 'DELTA'
    ) AS [decking_status_temp] 
WHERE 
    t_put >= '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 
    CAST(t_put AS DATE)
ORDER BY 
    date;
